messages.subject: For Renaud Adams | Responsible growth, HSEC and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear IAMGOLD Corporate Office,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Renaud Adams, President and Chief Executive Officer.

IAMGOLD's next phase combines operational delivery with a clear expectation that HSEC, community relationships and responsible growth remain embedded in how the portfolio performs. That execution challenge closely matches my operating background.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I coordinate complex external commitments across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement and technical teams.

I would value a conversation about where this experience might support IAMGOLD's responsible-growth, HSEC, stakeholder or country-facing leadership priorities. My attached CV is tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
